Usage of /opt/probes/bin/probe-go-flag:
  -auto-approve
    	skip interactive approval, a deliberately long description
    	that the author wrapped by hand
  -chdir DIR
    	switch to DIR before running
  -f	skip confirmation prompts
  -force
    	skip confirmation prompts (long spelling)
  -n count
    	maximum count of results
  -no-color
    	disable color
  -v	verbose
